# Gracious Love Academy

Gracious Love Academy is a leading CBC primary school located in Njomoko, Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya. We provide quality education from Play Group to Grade 6 under the Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) approved by KICD.

## About

Founded in 2023, Gracious Love Academy is committed to nurturing young minds through affordable, high-quality education. Our school is located near Kingdom Seekers Church in Thika, behind SK Suites.

- **Location:** Njomoko, near Kingdom Seekers Church, Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya
- **Phone:** +254 727 345 438
- **Email:** graciousloveacademy23@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://graciousloveacademy.netlify.app
- **Curriculum:** Competency Based Curriculum (CBC) — Play Group, PP1, PP2, Grade 1–6

## Programs

### Early Years (PP1 & PP2)
Play-based learning foundation preparing children for formal education. Ages 4–6 years.

### Lower Primary (Grade 1–3)
Building strong literacy and numeracy foundations through competency-based learning.

### Upper Primary (Grade 4–6)
Deepening knowledge and skills in preparation for junior secondary education.

## Fee Structure

- **Pre-Primary:** From KES 6,500/term
- **Lower Primary:** From KES 7,500/term
- **Upper Primary:** From KES 9,500/term

Flexible payment plans available. Download the complete fee structure PDF: https://graciousloveacademy.netlify.app/downloads/fee-structure-2026.pdf

## Admissions

We welcome new students throughout the year. To enroll:

1. Visit the school in person
2. Call +254 727 345 438
3. Email graciousloveacademy23@gmail.com
4. Fill in the contact form on our website
